newsitem.title: USA: Lukens sees Q4 loss from weak steel mart.
newsitem.headline: Lukens sees Q4 loss from weak steel mart.

text.p: Lukens Inc said on Tuesday it expects a fourth quarter loss due to weak stainless steel market fundamentals.

"Higher levels of low-priced, imported stainless steel pushed down U.S. prices during the third quarter, generating an operating loss at our Stainless Group," chairman and chief executive officer R.W. Van Sant said in a statement.
Van Sant said he does not see any immediate improvement in North American stainless market fundamentals.
Lukens reported earnings of $6.7 million on sales of $262.7 million in last year's fourth quarter.

Stainless cold rolled sheet imports achieved a 21 percent share of the U.S. market in the first seven months of 1996, compared with 13 percent in the year ago period, Lukens said, citing Specialty Steel Instutute of North America data.
Stainless plate imports gained a 20 percent share of the market, up 51 percent, Lukens said.
